note: SYNTHETIC. Fictional telco 'Meridian Mobile' — not a real company. No real customer data.

ground_truth.why_this_scenario_exists: 反例，专测「重复联系」这个信号会不会误报：客户确实联系了两次，但两次是**不同的事**，而且**都当场解决了**。真正的风险信号是「就同一件未解决的事反复来电」，不是「来过两次」。没有这个样本，系统可能把任何多次联系的客户都判成高风险。

contacts.summary: Customer can't get mobile data working after changing handsets. Agent walks them through the APN settings and it works before the call ends.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: I've just swapped to a new phone and I've got calls and texts but no mobile data at all.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: That's usually the APN settings not carrying across. Can you open settings and go to mobile network for me?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Right — set the access point name to internet, all lowercase, then toggle flight mode on and off.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Hang on… yep, there we go. It's connected. That was easy.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Glad that sorted it. Anything else while I'm here?

needs.summary: Get mobile data working on the new handset

evidence.speaker: customer
evidence.quote: I've got calls and texts but no mobile data at all

needs.resolution_note: Resolved during the call — APN corrected and data connected.

actions.summary: Talked the customer through correcting the APN; data restored on the call

evidence.speaker: agent
evidence.quote: set the access point name to internet, all lowercase

contacts.summary: A week later, an unrelated question about international roaming. Answered and a pack added on the call.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Different thing this time — I'm off to New Zealand next week and wanted to sort out roaming.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: There's a five dollar a day pack that covers calls and data over there. I can add it and set it to start on the day you fly.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Perfect, the fourteenth. Can you do that now?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Added, starting the fourteenth and it stops charging the day you land back. Nothing else for you to do.

needs.summary: Arrange international roaming for a trip to New Zealand

evidence.speaker: customer
evidence.quote: I'm off to New Zealand next week and wanted to sort out roaming

needs.resolution_note: Roaming pack added during the call, scheduled to start on the travel date.
